notes.title: UPDATE 1.60 NEW CONTENTS
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35310878/f86ef7daaf396400b3b2e32dbca881932b1bb719.png

Hey Governors, as I mentioned before your new update is ready. I implemented quest and patrol system. Quests have multiple endings so try to be adventurous to see other endings. All working great and it's right time to try it!

Keep in mind that you need to PATROL the region to find quests. Don't expect to find them without a hard work! Don't forget it's just the beginning   of better things.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35310878/5a04fbdf977c18a14d2704029801df7961c1e6fe.png

Version 1.6 Change Log

Enemies are more dangerous.
Rewards and item drop rates increased a lot!
Items are cheaper now! You can try different skills and armors right away.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35310878/2b95f661caf55e4088f03924ea52ba91e9ca9e4d.png

Every action has a reaction. Rule with justice or fear, it is all your choice but be aware of the consequences. Region events are activated. Also, you can rip the benefits of your respect. Remember that every alignment has it's own perks.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35310878/f7a8af18c86bbb7de8fdcd9db585bfab045c9c0e.png 

It's an early access game so you can help me to shape the game. Your ideas matter and  if you like to help me to improve the game you can write your ideas and feelings  here

notes.title: Update 1.51 is alive!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35310878/efd7b8d68ef886aa25d97a11f0c1b56a3990ca3f.png

I decided to update the game before all quests are ready! but you have plenty of new things to see and try like;

Many different types of enemies!
Respect can be tracked on inventory section. You are getting respect points from the quests! You can be good or evil!
One little "Missing Wife quest is here for you to try and to see what you will get in the future!
Minor adjustment to UI and AI. Enemies can hit harder beware!

notes.title: What do we have here? UPDATE 1.50
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35310878/3ea40931d00fcf7157d020b60dc7ab79c3af0bad.png

New update is ready, here is what you can expect from it;

Get ready for night fights! Nights come with new skills. You can blind, poison and disable your opponents by attacking to their guns or you can use blue diamond shells to heal yourself while they are suffering!

Our scientists are working on the wonders of this diamonds. We will update you as we progress, Governor.
